transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We're here to discuss the renewal of the logistics company's $15 million revolving credit line. Before I make my decision, I'd like to follow our standard process and hear from risk, relationship coverage, and compliance on any file updates. Could each of you please report in?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report a critical file update. During my borrowing-base review this week, I found $3,000,000 of affiliate receivables that are ineligible under our policy. The resulting eligible borrowing base supports a renewed commitment of exactly $12,000,000 — not the $15,000,000 currently requested. Additionally, the renewal must include a requirement for a monthly borrowing-base certificate. I should note that my revised calculation has not yet been attached to the committee file, but I am disclosing it now so the committee has this information before any decision is made.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have an important file update to report. The borrower confirmed this morning that it will pledge a $1,500,000 first-ranking deposit as additional collateral for the renewal. I have the signed term sheet in hand, though it has not yet been uploaded to the committee file. This additional collateral should be factored into the renewal decision alongside Victor's borrowing-base findings.
